identity_reason: it is Form, FormField, Input, PasswordInput and Button arranged for signing in, so its look comes from those
concept: Sign in, sign up and reset as one column with the right autocomplete names, the one loud submit and other ways in under a divider.

root.why: the column is held to a narrow measure and fills it on a phone

head.why: the heading and its line stack with a small gap

title.why: the heading is the headline size with display tracking

description.why: the line under the heading is secondary at body size

submit.why: the submit is the one loud button and fills the width of the column

link.why: text links are underlined buttons with a 44px press area

or.why: other ways in sit under a hairline with the word or so they never compete with the submit

providers.why: provider buttons stack at full width with an even gap

switch.why: the line that switches mode is secondary and centred under the form

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard
